exposure: premature complete closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus
cohort: Eight fetuses diagnosed with premature ductus arteriosus closure by prenatal ultrasonography at the Hunan Maternal and Child Health Hospital from July 2019 to August 2022
finding: Prenatal echocardiography parameters are helpful for predicting the prognosis of fetuses with premature closure of the ductus arteriosus, allowing for early detection, close observation, and clinical guidance for timing of delivery.
